entries.reason: Current direct measurements and independent history serve different consumers.
entries.acceptance: Retain until a replacement proves both historical SLI continuity and independent source verification.

entries.reason: Production selects direct mode; implicit legacy fallback was removed.
entries.acceptance: Verify every selector, a reference-free observation window, rollback from an older release and player qualification before removal. A date never triggers deletion.

entries.reason: The existing exporter still has active metric consumers.
entries.acceptance: Move consumers by metric family, preserving age, UNKNOWN and SLO semantics; prove no remaining consumer before stopping it.

entries.reason: Read-only transport evidence remains separate from recovery authority.
entries.acceptance: Qualify a read-only replacement with nonce, boot, generation and loss cases, then move consumers first.

entries.reason: Delivery is shared; incident state and outbox ownership remain separate.
entries.acceptance: Preserve pending and UNKNOWN receipts and provider acceptance; incident-owner consolidation needs a separate design.

entries.reason: The shared gateway cannot report its own complete failure.
entries.acceptance: Retain an independent direct provider path.

consumers: images and historical artifacts outside current bundle
entries.reason: The current bundle and image or historical publication have different consumers.
entries.acceptance: Inspect the loaded publisher and references; remove only migrated JSON paths while preserving the publish-only boundary.

entries.reason: The old Kubernetes monitoring stack is scaled down; the active host stack is separate.
entries.acceptance: Keep rollback data and configuration; do not delete storage automatically.

entries.reason: Physical colocation does not merge authority boundaries.
entries.acceptance: Consumer migration must retain the signed facts and recovery contracts under separate qualification.

entries.reason: OCI is the active heartbeat path; GCP public blackbox checks have a different purpose.
entries.acceptance: Do not confuse an inactive heartbeat candidate with active public blackbox checks.

player_qualification.scope: bounded on-demand YouTube embed and paired displayed clocks
